My travels / Vietnam

South · North · Central coast

A month
in Vietnam

Island time, city pauses, mountain roads and lantern nights. This is my Vietnam itinerary, organised by destination so you can make it your own.

Timings are approximate, with room to adjust the route as you go. Optional ideas are marked below.

Support local women

If you can afford to and would like to, consider donating to Peace House Shelters to support women and children experiencing domestic violence.

I don’t receive any money or commission from these donations. Supporting local women matters to me, and this is one small way to give back to the places I visit. It takes all of us to stand against gender-based and domestic violence.
